topic: Ecosystem Works production-chain prototype and 10,000-tile field architecture
currentUserGoal: Replace the short-run Scourge prototype with a production-chain survival loop that grows from one tile into saved multi-session fields, supports a real 100x100 logical grid, and remains isolated behind ?redesign&ecosystemPrototype until it is fun.
workCompleted: Created docs/ECOSYSTEM_FACTORY_DESIGN.md as the durable mechanics, save, rendering, progression, and performance contract.
Added a deterministic fixed-tick economy covering Dew, Moisture, Growth, Flowers, Pollinated Blooms, Seeds, Clippings, Compost, Humus, Root Energy, and buffered Care.
Implemented natural fallback recipes, storage backpressure without waste, rising Scourge demand, HP deficit damage, bottleneck reporting, RT income, and exact run summaries.
Added all eight helpers with distinct recipes, escalating run-local prices, alternate permanent modes, and five-second mode reconfiguration pauses.
Added permanent helper/mode unlocks, 10-rank throughput/storage/efficiency Memories, five starting-stock ranks, field-size Memories, Broad Palm, Many Hands, and Field Embrace.
Implemented run-local Cultivation ranks and the 1x1, 2x2, 3x3, 5x5, 8x8, 12x12, 20x20, 32x32, 50x50, 75x75, and 100x100 field ladder.
Implemented compact Uint8 tile state, Uint16 per-chunk stage counts, dirty chunks, sparse wound storage, bounded production-stage updates, and centered field expansion.
Implemented deduplicated touch batches with the approved Broad Palm radius/power curves, random Many Hands targets, Field Embrace chunk waves, and a 24-impact visual cap.
Added versioned permanent and active-field saves with compact base64 tile data, exact reload, periodic/purchase/page-hide writes, and deliberately zero offline advancement.
Built a polished Phaser field view with varied production-stage textures, randomized tile motion, pan/zoom, near/mid/far LOD, helper actors, pooled projectiles, touch waves, and a Living Ledger.
Built a dedicated full-screen Ecosystem Works graph with stocks, rates, blocked buffers, helper purchases, and mode switching at quarter simulation speed.
Built a separate full-screen Memory Nursery after Game Over with paged permanent nodes, non-crossing connectors, run summary, and an animated Begin Next Run action.
Built an Options overlay that completely pauses simulation and controls the existing music/SFX settings.
Added an actionable semantic DOM bridge with coordinate touching, helper/factory/Memory controls, readable stocks and chunk summaries, and bounded playtest controls.
Added isolated route handling and redesign-specific 32x32, 50x50, and 100x100 harness output without touching the public alpha or legacy GameScene.
verificationRun: npm run check passed: ESLint, 103 Vitest tests across 13 files, TypeScript, and the Vite production build.

Deterministic tests cover matching seeded simulations, storage pausing without input loss, nonnegative/capacity-bounded resources, mode cooldowns, touch deduplication, exact rank curves, cultivation-gated expansion, 10,000 real tile states, first-run 60-120 second pacing, second-run multi-minute pacing, quarter-speed Works, complete Options pause, exact save/resume, and viewport mapping.
Browser verification passed at 1280x720 and 390x844 for the active field, Living Ledger, Ecosystem Works, Options, and Memory Nursery.

Desktop 100x100 harness: 10,000 logical tiles, far LOD, 100 rendered chunk views, zero rendered tile views, zero full-field production scans, 6.95 ms latest frame delta, 7.92 ms maximum observed delta, and zero spikes in the measured pass.

Phone harness: 32x32 rendered 16 chunk views; 50x50 rendered 25; 100x100 rendered 100. All reported zero full-field production scans and no observed frame spikes; the final 100x100 phone pass reported about 6.95 ms latest and 11.81 ms maximum frame delta.
Agent DOM controls successfully started a next run and opened Options; elapsed simulation remained exactly 250 ms throughout a 450 ms browser wait while Options was open.
A semantic helper purchase produced Tiny Sprinkler x1, measurable Moisture/Care rates, a visible animated helper actor, and updated readable state.
The existing ?redesign&playtest scene still booted nonblank and unchanged after the isolated route was added.
git diff --check passed; only the repository's existing Windows line-ending notices were printed.

release.status: Isolated local prototype checkpoint. It is not merged into master or promoted to the public alpha.

currentGitStatus: Expected after checkpoint commit: clean codex/ecosystem-factory-prototype branch.
The local Vite server is running on http://127.0.0.1:5173.
The browser prototype save was reset to a fresh one-tile Run 1 after verification.
knownIssues: The full production graph is implemented but its mature-run economy is first-pass tuning; hands-on progression beyond the deterministic first two duration bands is still required.
Later bespoke Scourge disruptions are not designed yet; current Scourge pressure is the continuous Care-demand curve only.
The playtest control panel intentionally overlaps lower UI on small screens; it is absent without the playtest parameter.
Near-field pan/zoom and touch math have unit coverage, while prolonged hands-on navigation at every field tier still needs player testing.
Helper actions reuse the existing small effect assets and synthesized SFX; unique late-tier animation/audio identities remain a later polish phase.
The Memory Nursery is a functional paged node network, not the eventual enormous free-pan Memory web. Its progression data is structured so that view can grow independently.
nextRecommendedSteps: Play a fresh no-debug Run 1, unlock Tiny Sprinkler with the earned five GT, and continue through Runs 2-5 while recording where decisions or resources become dull.
Tune helper costs, Care output, capacity, and Scourge ramps from those hands-on timings rather than adding more systems immediately.
Add one meaningful Scourge disruption only after the base bottleneck decisions are proven readable and enjoyable.
Design the next Memory clusters and the eventual free-pan web around observed production choices, not filler ranks.
Promote or merge only after hands-on approval; the public alpha and legacy game remain deliberately untouched.
doNotRevert: Keep the prototype isolated behind ?redesign&ecosystemPrototype with its own saves and harnesses.
Do not cite or run the legacy 1,200-tile harness as evidence for this redesign.
Keep all 10,000 tiles as real compact logical state without creating 10,000 Phaser or DOM objects.
Keep production fixed-tick and aggregate; do not scan the full field during ordinary production frames.
Keep closed-game time inert: no resources, damage, or elapsed-time simulation while the page is closed.
Keep output-full recipes paused without consuming input and preserve natural fallback conversions.
Keep Game Over as a separate Memory Nursery state and keep helper/equipment rows hidden until their permanent Memory is owned.
Keep manual touch batches deduplicated and visual effects capped independently from the number of logical impacts.
